definition: This dimension controls the maximum level a character can achieve, which can vary from fixed caps to no cap at all. It influences the pacing of power progression and the longevity of gameplay by determining how long players can continue to grow their character's abilities.
exclusion_criteria: Games without any level progression system
Games where all characters start and remain at the same power level throughout
inclusion_criteria: Games with a defined maximum level
Games that allow for level progression beyond the initial cap through alternative systems
title: Level Cap Variability
